subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class II

source.read: Tamil Nadu State Board (Samacheer Kalvi) English textbooks for the class, term by term, read through third-party copies and summaries of their unit pages
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. Tamil Nadu publishes English as textbooks rather than as a line-by-line syllabus; this list is OpenPath's reading of what the units teach, gathered from summaries of the books. It is not checked against every term book.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)
